bng.text: Kydele, the Oracle of Kruphix in Meletis, remembers being spirited away by Kruphix to his true temple, from which she watched Xenagos become a god and Elspeth, with Ajani, cut him from the sky with Godsend.
She then saw Heliod murder Elspeth with her own weapon, and since that betrayal she feels dead inside and the voice of her god has fallen silent.

When Kruphix speaks to her again, she asks why it all feels so wrong, and he tells her that the gods are beliefs that took form within Nyx and that Theros is one of many worlds, though he warns her that knowledge is cruel.

Kruphix reveals his fear that the Eldrazi, an ancient dragon planeswalker and Phyrexia could destroy Theros while even the gods are powerless, and back in Meletis, [[Kydele, Chosen of Kruphix]] tells Diantha that she has learned nothing to share.

thb.text: In Theros Beyond Death, Kydele is spirited away by Kruphix himself when she is in danger, and he reveals to her that the gods did not create mortals but are products of mortal belief and faith.
Kruphix tells her of many worlds and of menaces beyond the gods, like the Eldrazi, Nicol Bolas and New Phyrexia.

Kydele returns to Meletis and keeps the knowledge to herself, and when Diantha confesses that she cannot hear Kruphix's voice and asks for insight, Kydele says after a long silence that there is nothing she can share.
